_comment: Known sites of the decision guards in Tests/Verbara.Sdk.Governance.Tests that fired on a defect already owned elsewhere when the guard landed. Each entry is {guard, path, key, reason, owner}: key is the whitespace-normalized text of the site (never a line number) and owner names the change that owns the fix. The match is EXACT: a site not listed fails its guard, and an entry whose site no longer fires fails it too, so the change that fixes a site deletes its entry in the same commit. Never add an entry to let a new violation in.

entries.reason: Each consume loop is handed to Task.Run gated on the bridge's stopping token (ADR-0058 R2). No observable effect: a skipped consume loop and one that ends at its first check both do nothing. The fix passes CancellationToken.None and deletes this entry.

StartAsync hands the accept loop to Task.Run gated on the start token (ADR-0058 R1/R2): a start whose token is already cancelled returns with the listener bound and the accept loop never runs. The fix passes CancellationToken.None and deletes this entry.
